name: dental-website-doctor
description: Assess a dental practice’s website the way a patient uses it: call, book, cost, emergency, the dentist. Measured findings and labelled opinions, each with a line for the practice and a line for the developer.

interface.shortDescription: Dental website assessment for dentists and their developers
interface.longDescription: Reviews a dental practice website as a patient would: can I call and book from my phone, is the dentist a real person, what will it cost, what do I do in an emergency. Adds dental-specific compliance checks (health details in forms next to ad pixels, advertising claims state boards police, patient photos without authorization) and labelled editorial opinions on copy and photos. Every finding is marked measured or opinion, dental-specific or general, with a plain-language line for the practice owner and a concrete fix for the developer. Public data only; no owner accounts, no forms submitted, no overall score.
capabilities: Assess public dental websites as a patient would
Flag HIPAA tracking and advertising-claim risks
Separate measured defects from editorial opinion
Explain fixes to dentists and to developers
defaultPrompt: What should my web developer fix first on my dental site?
Show me a fictional example assessment.
